data.summary: MCP initialize instructions (templates/prompts/mcp_instructions.md lines 58-74) embed volatile per-session text (crashed-worktree count, queue-loop count, rules drift, companion states, gate gaps, setup_todo, open choices) inside the system-prompt region: two lanes started minutes apart get different prefixes so cross-lane/subagent prefix cache sharing is lost and the instruction bytes are not ordered by change frequency. Fix: keep the handshake byte-stable (static contract only) and move the volatile lines to the first brief; covered in plan by CC-cache-policy (lint) but not by any task that moves them.

data.claim:
SCOE 'Beyond the prompt' talk (33 slides) vs ddflow. Verdict per slide group (P=PRESENT, PA=PARTIAL, A=ABSENT), evidence, covering ids.
1-5 charter/agenda: A (org practice, not tooling). Radar/adoption success measure: A (no adoption telemetry; P-observe.telemetry, UX-local-telemetry open).
6-7 precise prompt/toolkit overlap: PA. Rules+charter carry standing part (ddflow rule add --scope/--globs/--pin, mcp_instructions.md, rules charter); task body is free text, no readiness lint (no id).
8-10 vocabulary, lap, context layers, cache order: PA. Research docs context-compaction-cache.md/token-spend.md hold the facts (VERIFIED 2026-10-23); no enforced L0-L3 contract. FINDING: mcp_instructions.md lines 58-74 inject volatile counts/drift/companions into the handshake (bug B-mcp-instructions-volatile-prefix); brief opens with RESUME/lost-events (volatile first). CC-cache-policy, TE-cache-hygiene open.
11 quadratic bill: PA. Token-spend decision D-TE-* (cache TTL 1h done TE-subagent-ttl, poll<=240s done TE-poll-cadence, context caps done TE-context-caps); no per-run lap/cost model or 17x view. GV-step-cost, CC-usage-metrics, P-perf-metrics (30/53) open.
12 compaction/drift: PA. P-context-compaction 2/17 (CC-advisor, CC-resume-pack, CC-store open), govern.context_mark_1..3 = 0.6/0.75/0.85 (config), P-drift 1/19.
13 subagents cost: PA. ORC-usage-semantics done; ORC-subagent-attribution open; no delegate-pays threshold advisor.
14 cache alive: PA. TE-subagent-ttl, TE-poll-cadence done; D-model-routing safe-point switching with switch cost (GV-switch-cost open); ORC-model-pinning open; doctor warns when TTL unset.
15 L0-L3 ordering, cache breakers: A as contract/lint (CC-cache-policy open, the nearest).
16 price table: PA. DRV-model-catalog done (windows, prices, cache, limits as data with provenance, models.toml); TE-limit-aware-routing done (layered price and limit table). Output/reasoning ratio and tokenizer +30% not modelled as such.
17 levers vs two meters: A as a report (GV-regret, GV-eval, PM-quality-signals open; SW-ledger done: first-pass gate rate per family/model/kind).
18 models think longer per upgrade: A (no re-measure on model upgrade hook; SW-ledger is the data source).
19 effort classes M/L/X/R: PA. GV-complexity-score, GV-preset, GV-escalate (escalate one tier on repeated gate failure), GV-roles open (P-governor 2/33); no task effort/model/turn-cap field (task add has none); review.max_rounds=6 is the only cap analogue; R/spike-first = kind research exists (task add --kind).
20 nine rules: PA. 2 write once P (rules/AGENTS.md); 3 PA (P-lean-start 11/20, P-tool-diet 9/18, TE-bounded outputs); 5 PA; 7 PA; 8 P (hooks, pre-commit, gates); 9 PA.
21-23 baseline vs local: PA. Layers default<company<project<local<user (D-config-layer-order, D-user-highest-precedence-2026-11-06); DRV-packs done (digest-pinned company packs); P-org-config 0/18, GP-org, LP-override-record, LP-e2e open.
24 seven parts: commitments/principles P (rules with enforcement strength, pinned rules, decisions, goals/principles kinds; LP-kinds-coverage open); stack guides PA (rule --globs scope; codeguide companion); skills PA (ddflow ships skills/commands; GC-agent-files, P-agent-lifecycle.manifest-adopt, OB-model open); templates PA (P-doc-templates); knowledge/governance P (research/lesson/decision/ADR records); model evaluation PA (GV-eval open; reviewer ledger); tooling P (adopt installer, doctor, validation).
25 developer flow: install P (ddflow adopt / onboard, commit generated files; B-onboard 13/13 done); task card A (GV-complexity-score, GV-roles); skill invoke PA; stack guidance auto-load PA (rule globs injected on claim); validate P (gates, live_test, ci).
26 ideal run, loops rare: PA. Gate pipeline is deterministic+model; ddflow metrics stages shows gate re-runs, rework rounds; no first-pass-per-item/runs-per-merge headline (PM-quality-signals, FOC-gate-budget open).
27 skills by lifecycle: PA. Skills shipped for implement; lifecycle skill catalogue (shape/design/verify/ship) not; SPEC-docs, GC-spec-stage, PO-*, TM-* packs open.
28 guidance vs checks, pairing rule: P (r-evidence-over-assertion, enforcement strength, hooks block, gates 'exit code IS the evidence'; ddflow is AHEAD). Pairing rule not stated: A. Ownership of commitments: A (no owner field on rules; LF-health 'decisions without owner' open).
29 governance, evidence, cadence, ADR, stable ids: P/PA. ADRs = decisions with status proposed/accepted/superseded; rules have stable ids; cadence mechanism exists (SJ-cadence-compat, CM-packs-watch open); deliberate exceptions: waivers A (GP-waiver, RQM-strength, SEC-policy, LP-override-record open).
30 gate-failure feeds toolkit, prose gate: PA. lesson add + ddflow lesson verify (pattern re-scan) manual; no auto gate-finding->rule/lesson proposal (SW-ledger/WP-gate-yield done are detectors only; LP-contribute open); prose lint (Vale) pluggable: tool-gate binding SC-gate-binding open, companions list has no prose linter; standards gate is an agent gate (model judgement) today.
31 visibility/ownership/stacks/gates: A. constellation MR-views, MR-policy-floor, CN-sync open; no installed-version/baseline report across projects.
32 contribute: PA. LP-contribute, SM-improve-report open.
33 eight lessons: 1 start from done: A (no acceptance-criteria field on task add; body free text; GC-spec-stage open). 2 stages P (gate pipeline). 3 one home per fact: PA (layers; rule add --check/--duplicate-of dedupe; no cross-kind dup check memory/rule/CLAUDE.md). 4 keep findings: P (research/lesson/memory, ddflow recall, dedupe on add); auto-promotion A (LP-contribute open). 5 gate where it costs: P (tiered pipelines, fix-Bbd88c54354 trivial tier, kind_pipelines, FOC-gate-budget open). 6 people are gates: P (approvals engine, person-only commands, chat channel rule r-approval-chat-channel). 7 watch runs to merge, stop after N: PA (review.max_rounds, r-bounded-everything, metrics stages; no runs-to-merge and N-failures-ask knob). 8 improve the system: PA (lessons, rules; no closed loop).
SLIDE WEAKNESSES: numbers (17x, 4x, 15x, 7x, 280x) are single illustrative or vendor figures; effort tiers/turn caps (4/8/12/6) are unsourced defaults; 'Gates = NOT A MODEL' ignores that most real review gates (critic, standards) are models: ddflow labels them agent gates and requires cross-family; Vale-only prose gate is narrow; success = adoption counts, not outcome/cost per merged change; 'distance from intent' has no measurement method. ddflow is ahead on: enforced (not requested) gate pipeline, unavailable-is-not-pass, event-log provenance, layered config with person-only override, cross-family reviewers, bug-needs-failing-test, per-model cache/price facts as data.
IDEAS RANKED (value/effort): 1 byte-stable handshake + cache lint in doctor (high/low; CC-cache-policy plus bug). 2 runs-per-merge and first-pass rate per item headline in ddflow metrics (high/low; data exists in gate records; PM-quality-signals, SW-ledger). 3 task card record: model, effort, caps, skill, acceptance criteria, derived from kind/complexity, layered table in config (high/med; GV-complexity-score, GV-preset). 4 acceptance-criteria field plus readiness lint on claim (high/low-med). 5 N-failed-runs stop-and-ask knob (high/low; extends review.max_rounds, r-bounded-everything). 6 gate-finding to rule/lesson proposal (repeat finding threshold) and pre-flight of standards in agent loop (med/med; LP-contribute). 7 installed-baseline version/adoption report across projects (med-high/med; constellation MR-views, P-org-config). 8 rule owner/review-cadence/waiver with expiry (med/med; GP-waiver, LP-override-record). 9 cost/lap dashboard with quadratic effect, cached/fresh/output split and price table (med/high; GV-step-cost, CC-usage-metrics, P-perf-metrics). 10 pluggable prose-lint gate as companion (low-med/low; SC-gate-binding). 11 skills eval on realistic prompts across providers (med/high; tests/eval has only tool_diet).
BEST PRACTICE SOURCES (not re-fetched this run; verified earlier in docs/ddflow/research/context-compaction-cache.md, 2026-10-23): Anthropic prompt caching docs (docs.claude.com prompt-caching: prefix order tools>system>messages, up to 4 breakpoints, 5m/1h TTL, read 0.1x write 1.25x/2x); OpenAI prompt caching guide (automatic prefix, >=1024 tokens); Google Gemini context caching; Anthropic 'Effective context engineering for AI agents' and multi-agent research post (~15x tokens); Claude Code docs on subagents/agent teams and memory (CLAUDE.md hierarchy, path-scoped rules, skills progressive disclosure); Chroma 'context rot' study.
data.falsifier: A ddflow knob or task already delivers an item marked ABSENT (e.g. an acceptance-criteria field, runs-per-merge metric, rule owner field).
data.mechanism: Slide-by-slide mapping against ddflow commands, config knobs, templates and the task/phase queue (ddflow task/phase list --match, similar, config --explain).
data.probe: ddflow task add --help; ddflow rule add --help; ddflow help metrics; grep -n '{{' ddflow/templates/prompts/mcp_instructions.md
data.question: Can ddflow support the SCOE 'Beyond the prompt' (33 slides) way of working, and what gaps and ideas follow?

data.alternatives: Free-text body only (today); effort only via harness settings
data.consequences: Needs fields on task add/update, GV-complexity-score, GV-escalate; class numbers are SCOE's unsourced defaults, so ship as data with provenance
data.decision: Proposed: a task carries an optional card; defaults come from a configurable class table (mechanical, local, cross-cutting, research) keyed by kind and GV-complexity-score; escalation to the next class on gate failure and to the operator after N failures; the table layers default<company<project<local<user.
data.title: A task card (model, effort, turn cap, skill, acceptance criteria) is a layered record derived from task kind and complexity

data.alternatives: Keep volatile hints in the handshake for visibility
data.consequences: Moves 7 volatile handshake lines to brief; adds a doctor/test check
data.decision: Proposed: L0 static (charter, MCP contract) ; L1 slow (rules, decisions, project facts); L2 per task (body, acceptance); L3 per turn (brief, resume, last gate). No counts, timestamps or per-session state in L0/L1; doctor lints it and measures cache hit from usage.
data.title: Always-on text is ordered by change frequency and the handshake stays byte-stable

data.consequences: Reuses gate records; no new events
data.decision: Proposed: ddflow metrics reports first-pass gate rate and gate re-runs per merged item; [bounded] knob stops an item after N failed gate runs and asks the operator; label deterministic versus model gates in the report.
data.title: Runs to merge is a first-class metric with a stop-after-N-failures knob
